thread:
Maya: kicking off a quick thread to align on the SI onboarding journey map + badging play for the next hardware-enabled cohort. sketch here: https://docs.google.com/example-journey (WIP)
Anna: looking now. can we keep the timeline to 6 weeks max? teams need fast time-to-first-deploy. :stopwatch:
Diego: agreed on 6w. also need a clear HW access step — vendors often block week 2. add a 'pre-provision' signoff before cohort start.
Sam: +1. propose this checklist snippet for pre-provision:
```
- confirm SI contact + CLA signed
- HW voucher requested (serials list)
- infra playbook link shared
- test-run scheduled (30m)
```
Jules: love the checklist. question: do badges map to capabilities or to milestones? recommend capability badges (networking, deployment, monitoring) so they can plug into marketplace listings.
Maya: capability badges seems more reusable. also want a lightweight exam + lab verification per badge. lab should be 45m with a pass/fail artifact (log or PR).
Anna: can we automate badge issuance via our LMS API? if yes, need schema for badge metadata (SI name, badge id, issue_ts, evidence link).
Diego: I can prototype a webhook flow. sample payload:
```
POST /badging/webhook
{
  "si": "string",
  "badge_id": "string",
  "evidence_url": "string",
  "issuer": "Redwood Enablement"
}
```
Sam: ops-bot can pick up webhook and call LMS. tagging @ops-bot for infra tasks.
ops-bot: noted. creating infra story: RD-1281 to expose /badging endpoint, add rate limit, and HMAC auth. ETA 5 days.
Maya: thanks. two more items: 1) mentor cadre pairing rules (1 mentor per 4 SI teams), 2) KPI: time-to-first-deploy <= 21 days post-badge. add to the journey map.
Jules: mentor pairing sounds good. suggest mentor rotation every cohort to avoid fatigue.
Anna: action items for this thread:
- Diego: prototype webhook + sample payload (due in 3 days)
- Maya: update journey map + embed checklist and badging flow (due 2 days)
- Ops: RD-1281 infra story and HMAC spec (ETA 5 days)
- Sam/Jules: draft mentor rota + exam rubric (due 1 week)
Maya: I'll update the doc and ping everyone when it's ready for review. :memo: any blockers?
Diego: none from my side. will reuse existing LMS auth libs.
Sam: vendor access might need procurement signoff for some SI partners — flagging for sales sync.
Maya: noted, adding procurement gate at week 0 in map.
Anna: perfect. once prototype + infra exist, let's run a 2-team pilot next month.
Maya: cool — I'll draft pilot invite and criteria. thanks all. :tada:
